_doc._: Copy to config.json (gitignored; install.sh and the SD card kit create it). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key is optional (defaults below); a bad value is replaced by the default and reported in the journal and /api/state server.config_warnings. Restart gokart-kart after a change; rotate needs sudo bash install.sh + a reboot.
_doc.kart_id: 1-8. Display label only: the Heltec's own id (from its self lines) wins; a mismatch shows KART N? in red and is logged once.
_doc.pit_urls: Tried in order every map_poll_s for the map package + game zones (mDNS name, then the pit's IP).
_doc.beginner_mode: true hides driver-facing VESC fault alerts (the pit and the logs keep them).
_doc.map_orientation: heading_up (map turns with the kart, <= 120 deg/s, kart ~60 % down) or north_up; only while following.
_doc.follow_span_m: Metres shown across the map height while following (10-2000).
_doc.follow_resume_s: Following resumes this long after the last touch on the map (1-600).
_doc.mode_hold_ms: ECO/NORMAL/SPORT press-and-hold time in ms; 0 = plain tap (0-5000).
_doc.map_fps: Max map redraws per second while something moves (1-30); 30 while a finger is on the map.
_doc.bind: HTTP listen address (0.0.0.0: other machines can watch the page; commands stay localhost-only).
_doc.http_port: HTTP port of the driver page / API.
_doc.remote_cmd: true lets other machines POST /cmd, /api/demo and GET /api/sound-test (debug only).
_doc.tcp: host:port of the simulator's TCP server instead of serial (null on a kart).
_doc.status_poll_s: Send the read-only `status` request to the Heltec this often (also 1 s after connect / Heltec reboot).
_doc.cache_dir: Map package cache (null = <kart>/cache/map); game-state.json lives next to it.
_doc.max_log_mb: All session logs together are kept under this (oldest deleted at start, at each 64 MB rotation and every 5 min).
_doc.game: false = this kart ignores the pit's game zones (no boost/mud commands, no laps).
_doc.gps_correction: true = game positions += (pit surveyed - pit radio live fix), 30 s mean, only if under 25 m.
_doc.demo: Allow demo mode (hold the KART badge 3 s): a simulated kart drives the zones; the real Heltec is never written to.
_doc.demo_max_s: Demo ends by itself after this many seconds.
_doc.sound: Game sounds on the driver page (WebAudio through the HDMI panel speakers).
_doc.rotate: 0 or 180. Read by install.sh only: 180 = panel mounted ports-down (kernel video= rotate + touch calibration udev rule; reboot). Kart 2 runs 0.
